name: MP Materials

eyebrow.en: MP Materials Corp. · Class A · Las Vegas, Nevada
eyebrow.zh: MP Materials · A类股 · 内华达州拉斯维加斯

title.en: America's rare earth mine, backed by Washington.
title.zh: 美国的稀土矿，华盛顿撑腰。

lede.en: MP owns Mountain Pass, the only scaled US rare earth mine, and is building magnet factories. A Department of War deal sets a $110/kg price floor for its NdPr and fully contracts its new 10X magnet plant. NdPr output rose 41% last quarter, but the company is still losing money while it spends $500–600M on capex this year.
lede.zh: MP 拥有美国唯一规模化稀土矿 Mountain Pass，并在兴建磁材工厂。与战争部的协议为其 NdPr 设定每公斤 110 美元价格下限，并包销新建的 10X 磁材工厂。上季 NdPr 产量增 41%，但今年资本开支 5–6 亿美元，公司仍在亏损。

s.en: price protection from the Department of War

s.zh: 2026 第三季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock fell by more than half from its high near $100.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。股价较近 $100 的高点下跌逾一半。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Since mid-2025 revenue includes price-protection income from the Department of War ($17.6M in Q2 2026); reported product revenue was $108.5M. MP gives no revenue guidance, so there is no guidance bar.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。自 2025 年中起营收含战争部价格保障收入（2026 年第二季 1760 万美元）；产品收入为 1.085 亿。MP 不提供营收指引，故无指引柱。

s.zh: 含 1760 万价格保障收入

s.en: market ~$110; floor tops up the gap

p.en: The Department of War price floor of $110/kg and a fully contracted 10X magnet plant reduce commodity-price risk.
p.zh: 战争部每公斤 110 美元价格下限及包销的 10X 磁材工厂降低了商品价格风险。

p.en: NdPr sales topped 1,000 t for the second straight quarter and production should exceed 1,000 t in Q3.
p.zh: NdPr 销量连续两季超 1000 吨，Q3 产量预计超 1000 吨。

p.en: 2026 capex is guided at $500–600M, including the $80M 10X site. Free cash flow was −$223M in Q2.
p.zh: 2026 年资本开支指引 5–6 亿美元，含 8000 万美元 10X 厂址。第二季自由现金流 −2.23 亿。

p.en: Operating losses continue while magnet plants are built; the magnetics segment's revenue fell 17% during the transition.
p.zh: 磁材工厂建设期间仍有营业亏损；转型期间磁材板块收入下降 17%。

p.en: Management expects NdPr production above 1,000 t and realized prices in the high $90s/kg.
p.zh: 管理层预计 NdPr 产量超 1000 吨，实现价格每公斤 90 多美元。

p.en: Vertical construction has started; output is fully contracted.
p.zh: 主体建设已开工；产出已全部包销。

sources: Price, market cap and beta: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with MP Materials Corp..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 MP Materials Corp. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第三季至 2026 年第二季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: MP made good money in 2021–2022 when rare earth prices peaked, then burned cash every quarter since early 2023 as prices fell and it built downstream separation and magnet plants. Q2 2026 was the heaviest at −$223M, including the $80M purchase of the 10X site.
read.zh: 2021–2022 年稀土价格高企时 MP 盈利丰厚，此后价格下跌、公司兴建下游分离与磁材工厂，自 2023 年初起每季烧钱。2026 年第二季最重，为 −2.23 亿美元，含 8000 万美元购买 10X 厂址。

read.en: Capex is guided at $500–600M for 2026, with $308M spent in the first half. I assume about $120M a quarter in the second half and $150M a quarter in 2027, with operating cash flow slowly improving as NdPr volumes rise, for about −$355M over four quarters. Management says its $1.45B of cash fully funds the plan.
read.zh: 2026 年资本开支指引 5–6 亿美元，上半年已花 3.08 亿。我假设下半年每季约 1.2 亿、2027 年每季 1.5 亿，经营现金流随 NdPr 销量上升缓慢改善，四季合计约 −3.55 亿美元。管理层称 14.5 亿现金足以覆盖全部计划。

p.en: Over 60% of Q2 capex went to magnetics, including the 10X site.
p.zh: 第二季逾 60% 资本开支投向磁材，含 10X 厂址。
2026 年第二季偿债 6900 万美元。

p.en: The Department of War tops up NdPr sales to $110/kg; $17.6M in Q2.
p.zh: 战争部将 NdPr 售价补足至每公斤 110 美元；第二季 1760 万。

p.en: Sales above 1,000 t a quarter and Q3 production expected above 1,000 t.
p.zh: 季度销量逾 1000 吨，Q3 产量预计超 1000 吨。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes any new government funding, customer prepayments or debt.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入新的政府资金、客户预付款或债务。
